question: Once a crash has been recognized, can a sparse causal market-state genome identify the market trough within +/-7 trading sessions, preferably after rather than before the trough?
search_window: onset through trough+30 trading sessions; genome may fire only after onset
causality: All state features are available no later than prior session close. Derived changes/slopes use only lagged state.
genome: 1-4 sparse clauses; each clause chooses feature, direction, training-only quantile threshold; conjunction or 2-of-N logic; optional 1/2/3-session confirmation

fitness.preference: post-trough confirmation is cheaper than equally distant pre-trough anticipation
fitness.premature: Every firing earlier than trough-7 is heavily penalized; first firing is primary event
fitness.late: Firing after trough+7 is increasingly penalized
fitness.missing: No firing by trough+30 receives a large penalty

validation: Four leave-one-crash-out folds. For each fold, evolve and calibrate thresholds on three crashes only, freeze winner, score untouched fourth crash. Also run one four-crash descriptive fit, never treated as validation.
success_gate: At least 3 of 4 LOCO heldout crashes first-fire within +/-7 sessions, no heldout firing earlier than -7, and median absolute heldout error <=7. Four of four is strong support.
